description: Base: the tip (E086 code). Precondition, free: log the current whiten_bias_epochs value in step terms. Then verify, in an untimed compiled-graph dump, that the steps after the detach have no stem dgrad or bias-reduction kernels. This was the H2.15.1 premise, and code reading says it is already present. Change only the freeze point. Train the whitening bias for the first 0.2 epoch (~7 steps at bs 1536), with its own LR tensor decaying linearly to 0 over that window (hiverge), then switch to the existing whiten_bias_grad=False graph for the rest of training. Both graph variants already exist and are warmed up for 16 px; the 24/32 px shapes need only the detached variant. Decide with an off-seed run on seeds 3-10 plus two scored runs.
